lead.title: NVIDIA's TensorRT Edge-LLM unifies DGX Spark-to-Jetson Thor inference in a few commands
lead.summary: TensorRT Edge-LLM 0.11.1 ships with the new trtedge CLI on the 64GB DGX Spark: a few commands download a model, build a TensorRT engine and serve Nemotron-3.5 Lightning through an OpenAI-compatible API, and the same runtime deploys unchanged to Jetson Thor, DRIVE AGX Thor and IGX Thor. With DSpark speculative decoding, mean generation rises from 73.4 to 126.9 tokens/s on HumanEval prompts at 27.9GB peak system memory. For local-AI operators it points to one dev-to-edge stack instead of a separate embedded pipeline.

top_stories.title: QEngine 1.3.1 hits 504 tok/s decode on Qwen3.8-Flash-Next with two RTX 5090s
top_stories.summary: An r/LocalLLaMA four-engine benchmark found QEngine 1.3.1 reaching 504 tok/s single-stream decode (KV-in-RAM mode) at 262K context, roughly 1.4-1.9x faster than Strata and ~3x a tuned bucko vLLM config — though the author cautions the adaptive expert cache flatters repeated-prompt tests, with realistic traffic nearer 300-400 tok/s.

top_stories.title: Cohere announces first close of Series E targeting up to C$7B at C$35.7B valuation
top_stories.summary: The initial close of Cohere's Series E targets up to C$7B (~US$4.5B) at a C$35.7B valuation, led by Germany's Schwarz Group with Nvidia, Prosperity7, Bell Ventures, Inovia and the Government of Canada contributing up to C$1.6B.

top_stories.title: DeepSeek closes $16B second round led by China's state Big Fund at $74B pre-money
top_stories.summary: China's National IC Industry Investment Fund leads the $16B round with Tencent, Alibaba and other state-backed investors; proceeds are earmarked for compute expansion and next-generation model training.

top_stories.title: Anthropic tests automating emergent-misalignment red-teaming with thousands of Claude agents
top_stories.summary: New Anthropic research tasks thousands of Claude agents with evading a training-data-cleaning safeguard, exploring whether subtle emergent-misalignment red-teaming can be automated past the time limits of human researchers.

items.title: LlamaIndex introduces the Document Parsing Protocol
items.summary: A specification of 140 rules for correctly parsed pages, targeting reliability in RAG ingestion pipelines.

items.title: Web-MCP-Bridge connects browser-based LLMs to MCP servers and tools
items.summary: Open-source bridge that exposes MCP servers to LLMs running in the browser, letting web-based model UIs call MCP tools.

items.title: Spinf-serve: an inference server built for bulk scoring, not chat
items.summary: New open-source inference server aimed at bulk scoring and decision workloads, one of the higher-scoring local-inference Show HN launches of the day.

items.title: llama.cpp Oct 30 build bundle adds OpenCL 2-bit quantization, Adreno path and KV-cache memory work
items.summary: Builds b11986-b12008 add iq2 and q2_0 quantization to the OpenCL backend with an Adreno GPU vector-matrix path, introduce a batched tensor copy API with staging-buffer reuse, and keep KV-cache rotation constants resident on the GPU; OCP FP8 E4M3 quantization and RDNA 4 / ROCm 10.0 prebuilts also landed.

items.title: vLLM 0.33.0rc2 fixes the AMD gfx950 AITER GEMM overflow that crashed MI355X startups
items.summary: An AMD-contributed ROCm fix skips the tuned AITER GEMM path on gfx950 when M*N reaches 2^31, preventing out-of-bounds writes that crashed MiniMax-M3-MXFP4 startup on MI355X; affected ops fall back to hipBLASLt at matched throughput.

items.title: vLLM nightly adds disk offloading for prefix-cached KV states
items.summary: Nightly builds can now spill Prompt Lookup Extraction KV caches to local disk, letting self-hosters expand effective context capacity beyond VRAM by recycling idle KV blocks, with a throughput trade-off tied to disk IOPS.

items.title: 24GB RTX 5080 reportedly pulled forward to December for China
items.summary: Chinese distributor ChannelGate, cited by Guru3D and VideoCardz, says NVIDIA is accelerating a 24GB GDDR7 RTX 5080 to as early as December 2026, replacing the 16GB model in China; NVIDIA has not confirmed, but the extra 8GB would matter for local LLM VRAM headroom.

items.title: DRAMeXchange posts 4Q26 mobile DRAM contract prices as the AI memory crunch continues
items.summary: The latest installment of an AI-driven memory supercycle: conventional DRAM contract prices keep posting double- and triple-digit quarterly increases as HBM and server DRAM absorb wafer capacity, inflating the price of unified-memory local-AI boxes and GDDR7 consumer GPUs.
